sources.title: FAA Exemption No. 19111B — Zipline International, Inc.
sources.jurisdiction: US civil UAS; Part 135 package delivery; historical decision
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the complete 28-page FAA decision supplied from the public docket and independently confirmed its document page and attachment through a Chromium session.

regions.locator: PDF printed page 1, first substantive paragraph
regions.excerpt: allows the petitioner to conduct part 135 air carrier operations for commercial package delivery using an unmanned aircraft system (UAS).

regions.locator: PDF printed page 10, FAA response to DAA safety-standard comments
regions.excerpt: The exemption does not authorize the system.

sources.limitations: This is an operation-specific 2023 decision. Its stated termination date was September 30, 2025, and a later amendment is recorded separately. It is not a general DAA-equipment authorization or an unrestricted safety finding.

sources.title: FAA Exemption No. 19111C — Zipline International, Inc.
sources.jurisdiction: US civil UAS; Part 135 package delivery; historical decision
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the complete 19-page FAA decision supplied from the public docket and independently confirmed the docket page and attachment label through a Chromium session.

regions.locator: PDF printed page 7, Area of Operations plan requirements
regions.excerpt: Operator to provide their safety case for expansion comprised of an airspace analysis below 500 ft

regions.locator: PDF printed page 19, effect of FAA decision
regions.excerpt: extends the termination date to October 31, 2026, unless sooner superseded or rescinded.

sources.limitations: The decision records conditions and a dated operating authorization. It does not publish all proprietary evidence, grant a general learned-perception approval, or establish permission after its stated termination date.

sources.title: TSO-C211a: Detect and Avoid (DAA) Systems
sources.inspection_scope: Inspected the complete 15-page FAA TSO supplied by the user, including purpose, applicability, performance basis, and installation-limitation language.

regions.excerpt: minimum performance standards (MPS) your DAA equipment must first meet for approval

regions.locator: PDF printed page 8, section 5.b.(3), installation limitations
regions.excerpt: Installation of this article requires separate approval.

sources.limitations: A TSO defines equipment approval requirements; it is not a list of authorization holders and does not approve a particular aircraft installation, operational domain, or learned model.
